integrity: A self-contained exact symbolic verifier accompanies an analytic spectral perturbation and compactness proof. Numerical tests are checks, not infinite-time proof. No independent scientific validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact coherent two-unit-row, iid uniform, consistent real planar Kaczmarz with beta=0 and zero initial velocity only. Pointwise initial derivative for 0<c<1; global optimality asymptotic only for sufficiently small coherence. Squared Euclidean iterate error, not signed mean, finite-sample, nonlinear, inconsistent, or arbitrary-row systems. Absolute literature priority is not independently established.
title: Coherence activates mean-square acceleration in two-row randomized Kaczmarz momentum
